welcome.headline: Find a game. Show up. Play.

map.title: Games around you
map.body: See pickup games and venues on the map, and join in a couple of taps.

fairPlay.title: Fair play
fairPlay.body: Check-ins and reliability scores help everyone count on each other.

chat.title: Chat with your squad
chat.body: Talk to the players in your game. Messages can be translated for you.

phone.title: What’s your phone number?
phone.body: We’ll text you a code to confirm it’s you.
phone.invalid: That phone number doesn’t look right. Check it and try again.
phone.consent: By continuing, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
phone.offlineHint: Connect to the internet to get a code.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.label: Verification code, 6 digits
otp.wrong: That code doesn’t match. Check the latest SMS or resend.
otp.expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
otp.tooMany: Too many tries. You can request a new code in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
otp.resendReady: You can request a new code now.

ageGate.title: Your birth month and year
ageGate.body: Sport Talent is for people 18 and older. We ask for your birth month and year only.
ageGate.privacyNote: We use this only to check your age. Other players never see it.

under18.title: Sorry, you need to be 18 or older to use Sport Talent.
under18.body: We haven’t kept what you entered. You can’t try again on this device for 24 hours.

profileSetup.title: Set up your profile
profileSetup.displayNameHint: This is how other players see you.
profileSetup.sportsHint: Pick the sports you play. You can change them later.
profileSetup.homeAreaHint: Helps us show games near you. The map works without it.
profileSetup.genderHint: Only used to let you join women-only games. Other players never see it.

location.title: Find games near you
location.body: Sport Talent uses your location to show games and venues around you. You can change this at any time.
location.deniedHint: Location is off. Search for a city to find games.
location.disclosure: Sport Talent uses your location to show nearby games and courts and to confirm your check-in when you tap Check in at a game. Location is used only while you use the app. You can search by city instead.

notifications.title: Stay in the loop
notifications.body: Get a reminder before your games and a heads-up when a host replies.

demo.hint: Demo mode: use the code {code} to sign in.
